protocol.data: development reservoirs only (the study run's 220 realisations)
protocol.outer_cv: 5-fold GroupKFold over reservoirs, shuffled with seed 0
protocol.inner_cv: 4-fold GroupKFold inside each outer training part
protocol.search: RandomizedSearchCV, n_iter=20 per family (V5: x3), same families as the published pipeline
protocol.selection_rule: family with the lowest inner grouped-CV RMSE
protocol.comparison: paired reservoir-level bootstrap (2000 resamples) vs V0

decisions.interval_rule: smallest mean relative width with mean whole-reservoir coverage >= 0.88
